scrimmage record: 1 test, 1 run; records in ROOT/scrimmage-runs/FOLDER
t  RUN  answered  wrote 2
wrote 2 mocks to ROOT/scrimmage.recorded.toml; ROOT/scrimmage.toml is unchanged
recorded 2 of 2 calls that needed a mock
warning: the mocks hold replies from real systems, which can hold customer data; check them before you commit them
note: replaced ROOT/scrimmage.recorded.toml, which an earlier record wrote; rename a file to keep it
note: 1 run answered with no model call
note: tool:get_order is under real and now has a mock with args: a call with other arguments runs for real; remove it from real if that call should be refused
model calls cost $0.0000 of no budget
next: diff ROOT/scrimmage.toml ROOT/scrimmage.recorded.toml, then scrimmage test ROOT/scrimmage.recorded.toml
--- ROOT/scrimmage.toml
+++ ROOT/scrimmage.recorded.toml
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
+# Written by scrimmage record from scrimmage.toml on DATE. Review it, then rename it to scrimmage.toml.
 [agent]
 function = "bot:answer"
 tools    = ["bot:get_order", "bot:stock"]
@@ -8,3 +9,19 @@
 name     = "t"
 question = "q"
 expect   = ["ok"]
+
+# scrimmage record, DATE, RUN: tool:get_order with {"order_id": "1"}, 1 call. It answers only these arguments.
+[[test.mock]]
+call     = "tool:get_order"
+recorded = true
+args     = {order_id = "1"}
+returns  = {order_id = "1", status = "shipped"}
+
+# scrimmage record, DATE, RUN: http:localhost GET /stock/1, 1 call.
+[[test.mock]]
+call     = "http:localhost"
+method   = "GET"
+path     = "/stock/1"
+recorded = true
+status   = 200
+json     = {count = 3}
